name: Kiryuu Miori
source:
The girlfriend of [url=https://vndb.org/c110975]Yuuji[/url]. They go to the same university.

She had a boyfriend before, but when Yuuji heard they broke up, he approached and confessed to her, which lead to them dating. 

Kind, timid, and is quite a pushover. 

The story began when she was seen by Yuuji having sex with another man. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/096/index.html]Official Site[/url]
